description: This mod adds a silent step feature

mods.name: Quiet Walk
mods.description:
Sprint disabled. Walk=CS2 run, Ctrl=CS2 silent walk, Shift=CS2 crouch. Sneaking is silent, keeps gun pose straight, and improves TaCZ accuracy.

Sprint is completely disabled.
Normal walk speed matches CS2 running speed (1.3x vanilla walk).
Press and hold Left Control (Ctrl) to walk quietly at CS2 silent walk speed (52% of running speed).
Sneaking (Shift) moves at CS2 crouch speed (34% of running speed).

Footstep sounds are completely silenced while quiet walking and sneaking.

Sneaking keeps the TaCZ gun pose straight (no tilt).
Sneaking also improves TaCZ gun accuracy: both hipfire and aimed spread
are reduced by a configurable factor (default 50% less spread).
Works with or without TaCZ installed (accuracy boost and gun pose only apply if TaCZ is present).

All settings are configurable in quietwalk-common.toml.
